*Changes: Updated all maps to reflect CDs, added the 4 new maps based on Rose's suggestions, upgraded some pop-up styling.*

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("../code/01_load_dependencies.R")
# Load the data and transform to standard longitude/latitude (WGS84) for Leaflet
cd_final <- st_read("../data/processed/cd_final_equity.geojson") %>%
  st_transform("+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84")
```

```{r map-setup}
# 1. Structured Pop-Ups
labels_cd <- paste(
  "<div style='font-family: \"Open Sans\", Helvetica, sans-serif; min-width: 220px; font-size: 13px; color: #333;'>",
    "<h3 style='margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8px; padding-bottom: 5px; border-bottom: 2px solid #8744BC; color: #000;'>",
      "Council District ", cd_final$councildist, 
    "</h3>",
    "<h4 style='margin: 10px 0 4px 0; color: #555; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;'>Demographics</h4>",
    "<div style='margin-left: 8px;'>",
      "<b>Total Population:</b> ", scales::comma(cd_final$TotalPop), "<br>",
      "<b>Median Income:</b> ", scales::dollar(cd_final$MedInc), "<br>",
      "<b>Non-Hispanic White:</b> ", round(cd_final$Perc_NHWhite, 1), "%",
    "</div>",
    "<h4 style='margin: 10px 0 4px 0; color: #555; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;'>Vulnerable Groups</h4>",
    "<div style='margin-left: 8px;'>",
      "<b>Under 18:</b> ", scales::comma(cd_final$Pop_Under18), " (", round(cd_final$Perc_Under18, 1), "%)<br>",
      "<b>Over 65:</b> ", scales::comma(cd_final$Pop_Over65), " (", round(cd_final$Perc_Over65, 1), "%)<br>",
      "<b>SNAP Households:</b> ", round(cd_final$Perc_SNAP, 1), "%",
    "</div>",
    "<h4 style='margin: 10px 0 4px 0; color: #555; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;'>Park Access <small>(Acres per 100k)</small></h4>",
    "<div style='margin-left: 8px;'>",
      "<b>Overall:</b> ", scales::comma(round(cd_final$facre_pc * 100000, 1)), "<br>",
      "<b>Under 18:</b> ", scales::comma(round(cd_final$facre_pc_under18 * 100000, 1)), "<br>",
      "<b>Over 65:</b> ", scales::comma(round(cd_final$facre_pc_over65 * 100000, 1)),
    "</div>",
  "</div>"
)

# park_access outline for bottom 25% of CD park access
recode <- cd_final %>% mutate(bottom25 = ifelse(facre_pc * 100000 < quantile(facre_pc * 100000, 0.25, na.rm=T), 1, 0))
rr <- HTML('<small> Source: Councilcount (ACS), NYC Parks </small>')
park_access <- HTML('<div style="color: #8744BC;"> <strong>Bottom 25%</strong> <br>  Park Access</div>')
```

```{r helper-map-function}
# 2. Dynamic Binning 
generate_map <- function(data, variable, palette_colors, title, label_format, color_outline = "#8744BC", round_digits = 0) {
  
  dynamic_breaks <- classInt::classIntervals(variable[!is.na(variable)], n = length(palette_colors), style = "jenks")$brks
  dynamic_breaks <- round(dynamic_breaks, round_digits)
  
  if (round_digits == 0) {
    dynamic_breaks[1] <- floor(min(variable, na.rm = TRUE))
    dynamic_breaks[length(dynamic_breaks)] <- ceiling(max(variable, na.rm = TRUE))
  } else {
    dynamic_breaks[1] <- floor(min(variable, na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10
    dynamic_breaks[length(dynamic_breaks)] <- ceiling(max(variable, na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10
  }
  
  dynamic_breaks <- unique(dynamic_breaks)
  pal <- colorBin(palette = palette_colors, domain = variable, bins = dynamic_breaks, na.color = "#CACACA")
  
  leaflet(options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = FALSE)) %>%
    setView(-73.984865, 40.710542, 10.5) %>%
    setMapWidgetStyle(list(background= "white")) %>% 
    
    # --- Map Panes defined here ---
    addMapPane("basePane", zIndex = 410) %>% 
    addMapPane("outlinePane", zIndex = 420) %>% 
    
    addPolygons(data = data, 
                weight = 1, opacity = 0.5,
                color = ~pal(variable), 
                fillColor = ~pal(variable),
                fillOpacity = 0.8, 
                popup = lapply(labels_cd, HTML),
                highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
                  weight = 3, color = "#FFFFFF", fillOpacity = 1, bringToFront = TRUE
                ),
                # Assign colored districts to basePane
                options = pathOptions(pane = "basePane")) %>% 
    
    # Bottom 25% outline
    addPolygons(data = recode, weight = 2, fill=F, opacity = 1,
                color = color_outline, stroke = recode$bottom25,
                # Assign purple outline to outlinePane so it stays on top
                options = pathOptions(pane = "outlinePane", interactive = FALSE)) %>% 
    
    addLegend(position ="topleft", pal = pal, opacity = 0.9, values = variable,
              title = title, labFormat = label_format) %>% 
    addControl(rr, position = "bottomright") %>% 
    addControl(park_access, position = "topleft")  
}
```

```{r create-maps}
# 3. Create & Save

# a) Park Access (Rounded to nearest whole acre)
map_acres <- generate_map(cd_final, cd_final$facre_pc * 100000, 
                          c('#eaf5ef', '#b6d4bd', '#83b48d', '#4f9560', '#007534'), 
                          "<strong>Park Acreage:</strong><hr><small>Per 100k Residents</small>", 
                          labelFormat(), round_digits = 0)

# b) Median Income (Rounded to nearest dollar)
map_inc <- generate_map(cd_final, cd_final$MedInc, 
                        c('#d5dded', '#afb9db', '#8996ca', '#6175b8', '#2f56a6'), 
                        "<strong>Median Household Income</strong><hr>", 
                        labelFormat(prefix = "$", big.mark = ","), "#800000", round_digits = 0)

# c) NH White (Rounded to 1 decimal place)
map_nhw <- generate_map(cd_final, cd_final$Perc_NHWhite, 
                        c('#e6dfd3', '#cfbea5', '#b79e7a', '#9e7f4f', '#846126'), 
                        "<strong>Non-Hispanic White</strong><hr>", 
                        labelFormat(suffix = "%"), round_digits = 1)

# d) Under 18 Population Count
map_u18 <- generate_map(cd_final, cd_final$Pop_Under18, 
                        c('#fce4ec', '#f8bbd0', '#f06292', '#e91e63', '#880e4f'), 
                        "<strong>Under 18 Population</strong><hr>", 
                        labelFormat(big.mark = ","), round_digits = 0)

# e) Acres per 100k Under 18
map_acres_u18 <- generate_map(cd_final, cd_final$facre_pc_under18 * 100000, 
                              c('#eaf5ef', '#b6d4bd', '#83b48d', '#4f9560', '#007534'), 
                              "<strong>Park Acreage:</strong><hr><small>Per 100k Under 18</small>", 
                              labelFormat(), round_digits = 0)

# f) Over 65 Population Count
map_o65 <- generate_map(cd_final, cd_final$Pop_Over65, 
                        c('#fff3e0', '#ffcc80', '#ff9800', '#f57c00', '#e65100'), 
                        "<strong>Over 65 Population</strong><hr>", 
                        labelFormat(big.mark = ","), round_digits = 0)

# g) Acres per 100k Over 65
map_acres_o65 <- generate_map(cd_final, cd_final$facre_pc_over65 * 100000, 
                              c('#eaf5ef', '#b6d4bd', '#83b48d', '#4f9560', '#007534'), 
                              "<strong>Park Acreage:</strong><hr><small>Per 100k Over 65</small>", 
                              labelFormat(), round_digits = 0)

# h) % SNAP / Public Assistance 
map_snap <- generate_map(cd_final, cd_final$Perc_SNAP, 
                         c('#e1f5fe', '#81d4fa', '#29b6f6', '#039be5', '#01579b'), 
                         "<strong>Households on SNAP</strong><hr>", 
                         labelFormat(suffix = "%"), round_digits = 1)

# Save 
saveWidget(map_acres, file = "../figures/cd_acreage.html")
saveWidget(map_inc, file = "../figures/cd_median_income.html")
saveWidget(map_nhw, file = "../figures/cd_NH_White.html")
saveWidget(map_u18, file = "../figures/cd_under18.html")
saveWidget(map_acres_u18, file = "../figures/cd_acreage_under18.html")
saveWidget(map_o65, file = "../figures/cd_over65.html")
saveWidget(map_acres_o65, file = "../figures/cd_acreage_over65.html")
saveWidget(map_snap, file = "../figures/cd_SNAP.html")

# Display
map_acres
map_inc
map_nhw
map_u18
map_acres_u18
map_o65
map_acres_o65
map_snap
```
